title: My Family and School
text:
Hello, I am Carlos. I am eleven years old. I have five subjects at school. My favorite subject is science. We look at plants and animals.

My sister Lucia is in high school. She likes history and English. She reads books every night. On Saturday, we study together at home.

questions.text: How do Carlos and Lucia probably feel about studying together?

vocabulary.definition: a topic you study at school
with another person or other people

paragraph_translations: Hola, soy Carlos. Tengo once años. Tengo cinco asignaturas en la escuela. Mi asignatura favorita es la ciencia. Miramos plantas y animales.
Mi hermana Lucía está en el instituto. Le gustan la historia y el inglés. Lee libros todas las noches. El sábado, estudiamos juntos en casa.
